Q2i.question: Every remaining field and nonsplit determinant
Q2i.finding_ids_or_current_gate: Every split class-number-one sixfold, every Eisenstein determinant and Gaussian signed determinant class3 has a numerical detector bound. Other nonsplit determinants remain open. Curve sources require actual original-field descent and period rank9. Original reflection-free coefficient degree>=15; inducing dimensions1/2/3 and non-Eisenstein7 are excluded. The remaining inducing4/5/6/8 exceptional profiles are exactly D-BI11/12,D-R5,D-BI16,HD-E8IF1; the explicit paired G33 Nielsen component is excluded, other components/descent remain. D-BI13/14/14a/15 impose the stated ramification, degree and nonnormality bounds. For every primitive factorwise tensor-indecomposable inducing degree>=5, D-BI19 forces an irreducible transitive quasisimple central-product core. D-BI18/20 excludes extraspecial cores and Lie fieldsq>=29 in degree>=10, with stronger ESD bounds. All sporadic, allA1, allSuzuki/Ree/Tits cores are excluded (D-SPOR,D-BI21/22). Odd symplectic Weil cores reduce to singleSp4(3)degree4/5; D-SPW04 gives the same nonsplit non-Eisenstein endpoint for all its representations. Other small-field higher-rank Lie cores remain. All spin2.An,n>=8, and all ordinaryAn,8<=n<=14, are excluded (HD-SPIN02,HD-ALT02,D-AST). HD-ALT03 forces any remaining ordinaryAn,n>=15,to have a row/column>ceil(n/2); its factors extend to real Specht modules and the inducing image is ESD. The all-degree scalar single-factor standard,exterior-square andunordered-pair cases remain excluded; long-shape tensor cases and residualA7/covers remain. These are necessary supplier restrictions, not existence results. The non-curve alternative is Q5i.

Q5i.question: Can a genuine balanced-RM split-eightfold perfect-complex seed be constructed?
Q5i.finding_ids_or_current_gate: No genuine balanced-RM weakly equivariant semiregular eightfold seed has been constructed. SF-E801--E810 excludes the stated rational-block, integrality and CI-secants; the actual semiregular coneSF-E814 has two-pure character and does not meet this gate. SF-E811--E813 excludes stable/polystable locally free objects and semistable bundles with locally free stable factors. SF-E818 extends this to torsion-free objects with such locally free hulls. SF-E817 excludes all nonzero point defects with a locally free hull, without stability/simplicity. SF-E819/E819R includes nonpure coherent objects: locally free hull with finite kernel/cokernel requires equal lengths at each point, and every nontrivial point must have a nonreduced defect module. The actual rank36 nonpure balanced construction fails this test. Locally free objects with zero defect require the separate stability exclusions. SF-E815/R excludes the stated simple positive-aggregate projectively-flat models; the seven-class model requiresEndG>=63. SF-E816/a/b/c excludes ordinary-gluable primitive projectively-flat models in any two cohomology degrees, including overlaps/arbitrary gaps, and arbitrary amplitude with globally disjoint classes. Remaining: unstable bundles, singular stable factors/reflexive hulls, nonreduced equal-length point modifications, positive-dimensional torsion/defects outsideE818, overlapping classes in at least3cohomology degrees, twisted or sufficiently nonsimple objects, and broader class spaces. The pure counterexampleE816d does not supply a balanced seed.
